title: GRAVY FOR WILD FOWL
instructions: --Put into a small saucepan a blade of mace, piece of lemon peel, two tablespoonfuls each of mushroom catsup,  walnut catsup and strained lemon juice, two shallots cut in slices, two wineglasses of port wine. Put the pan over the fire and boil the contents; then strain, add it to the gravy that has come from the wild fowl while roasting. If there is a large quantity of gravy less wine and catsup will be necessary.
